current_state.zh: HKEX partnered with S&P Dow Jones Indices to launch the S&P 500 HKEX Tech 100 Index, a cross-market benchmark blending US-listed leaders with Hong Kong's largest tech companies, positioned to enable Stock Connect-eligible ETFs tracking it.
current_state.en: HKEX partnered with S&P Dow Jones Indices to launch the S&P 500 HKEX Tech 100 Index, a cross-market benchmark blending US-listed leaders with Hong Kong's largest tech companies, positioned to enable Stock Connect-eligible ETFs tracking it.
